scope.extra_artifacts: All registry/uap/JANUS-UAP-R1.* and JANUS-UAP-TACHYON-R1.* JSON present at source commit; plus R1.2A receipt from separate pinned branch
scope.coverage: Each indexed path re-read, blob verified, structured leaves mirrored and explicit references reversed. Broad discovery paths are not evidence. Parse errors quarantined; no fabricated time order.

retina.rule: Regenerate all 288 frozen synthetic cubes; match original input SHA and native score; reverse time axis only, same positive calibrated dt and role ordering; replay twice restores bytes. Score differences descriptive; no veto.

measurement.gw: Reacquire both exact SHA-bound HDF5 files, reverse same fixed preprocessed interval and matched controls; signed lag must flip under reversal while absolute score unchanged within tolerance. Acausal filtering is OFFLINE ONLY, cannot establish signal front.
measurement.chime: Reacquire exact CSV digest; reverse catalog row order (not physical time), preserve DM; no raw pulse inference.
measurement.opera: Published summary only; invert sign as coordinate convention, do not claim reversal of neutrino event.
measurement.uap: Reverse actual UTC-normalized reported observations separately from archival report date; do not merge distinct witnesses or invent object position.

physical_hypotheses: H0 ordinary causal history incl. noise, clock, instrument, selection and common cause
H1 apparent time symmetry or reverse reconstruction
dimensions: D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC explicit shared references/competing causes; no similarity as evidence

controls.synthetic_egg: Constructed irreversible-looking stages with two distinct forward histories yielding identical terminal state; reverse reconstruction must retain both. No biological simulation or evidence.
controls.temporal: Known causal waveform and its numerical reversal, symmetric control; signed feature flips for asymmetric sample, symmetric no direction.
controls.lorentz: Exact interval sign invariant under t->-t; coordinate order not physical causal mechanism.
controls.criteria: No carrier promotion, no automatic veto. Report matched ordinary controls and remaining ambiguity. Do not infer future causes from backward reference links.

science_gate: H4/H5 HOLD unless independently calibrated exclusive carrier observable, same physical UAP pair, independent prospective replication. Numerical reversal never changes historical chronology.
execution: Fresh research branch; source-bound data analysis in read-only job; publish only JSON result. Uses canonical protocol as executable new adapter; original domain-specific Giza/Cousteau engine is not generalized unchanged.
